preconditions.description: The number of words in the text must be between 1 and 300.

preconditions.expression: all(len(word) > 0 and word.islower() for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word must consist only of lowercase Latin letters and must not be empty.
The total length of the text, including spaces, must not exceed 100000 characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum length of the text after at most one abbreviation.
